title: Control + Backup
description: Creating backups with only one key and you can do it in game.
body: Have you ever lost hours of progress because Minecraft crashed, and your automatic backup was too old? Control+Backup is a lightweight, intuitive tool that puts world safety back into your hands. Forget about quitting to the main menu or digging through Windows folders to find your save files. Creating backups with only one key and you can do it in game.
